response.sql: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_tc FROM station_counts) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bandusage, s.telescope_count, s.telescope_count * 1.0 / a.avg_tc AS ratio FROM station_counts s CROSS JOIN avg_count a ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10;
